related.title: stale-while-revalidate：回應延遲與背景更新
related.titleEn: stale-while-revalidate: response latency and background refresh
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受區間合法、body長度一致且validator匹配；1000000以外索引需按規範拒絕或處理。 交接時須能核對：交付 range-parts.csv、同版本重組hash與版本變更拒絕測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require valid ranges, matching body length and validators; indices beyond1000000 require protocol-compliant handling. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver range-parts.csv, same-version reconstruction hashes and a changed-version rejection test.
related.difference: 將fresh、可背景刷新stale、超出容許三種狀態分開，不把後兩者都當快取成功。
related.differenceEn: Separate fresh, stale-with-background-refresh and beyond-allowance states rather than treating both latter cases as ordinary hits.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
HTTP byte range兩端為包含式；Content-Range及資源validator需對應同一表示。
教學基準：1999-1000+1 = 1000 B；對照：999999-999000+1 = 1000 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

stale-while-revalidate提供額外允許期，與max-age新鮮期相加但不是永久延長。
教學基準：60+30-75 = 15 s allowance margin；對照：60+30-95 = -5 s allowance margin。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
HTTP byte-range endpoints are inclusive; Content-Range and the resource validator must describe the same representation.
Teaching baseline: 1999-1000+1 = 1000 B; comparison: 999999-999000+1 = 1000 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

stale-while-revalidate adds a permitted window beyond max-age, not an indefinite renewal.
Teaching baseline: 60+30-75 = 15 s allowance margin; comparison: 60+30-95 = -5 s allowance margin. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: YANG 通知訂閱：推送負載與訂閱生命週期
related.titleEn: YANG notification subscriptions: load and lifecycle
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受區間合法、body長度一致且validator匹配；1000000以外索引需按規範拒絕或處理。 交接時須能核對：交付 range-parts.csv、同版本重組hash與版本變更拒絕測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require valid ranges, matching body length and validators; indices beyond1000000 require protocol-compliant handling. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver range-parts.csv, same-version reconstruction hashes and a changed-version rejection test.
related.difference: 以subscription ID、filter、狀態與event time建帳本，終止後不得繼續累加事件。
related.differenceEn: Ledger subscription ID, filter, state and event time; terminated subscriptions must stop generating records.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

訂閱式通知有建立、修改、終止及錯誤狀態；推送傳輸成功不代表應用已處理。
教學基準：120/2*800 = 48000 B/s mean；對照：120/5*800 = 19200 B/s mean。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Teaching baseline: 1999-1000+1 = 1000 B; comparison: 999999-999000+1 = 1000 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Notification subscriptions have establish, modify, terminate and error states; transport delivery does not prove application processing.
Teaching baseline: 120/2*800 = 48000 B/s mean; comparison: 120/5*800 = 19200 B/s mean. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
